decisions.reason: The polymer concrete housing kept its own page through 2019 and supports the firm's established drainage families, so the investment already made and its fit with the core business argue for keeping it.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the announced direction toward accessible, low-profile systems, and its visibility grew to its own page in 2019, so the firm is strongly committed to it.

Its visibility dropped from its own page to a mere mention, but as the publicly presented flagship of the design direction, management would likely blame weak results on temporary causes and persist with it.
The shower element with integrated slope fits the integrated, renovation-friendly direction, even though its modest visibility means the firm has committed to it less strongly.
The backflow-protected basement drain was launched with specific claims and featured on the home page in 2019, a visible public commitment that makes dropping it unlikely.
The air-admittance valve is peripheral to the firm's announced direction and has had low visibility, but as a cheap complementary product within the drainage range, keeping it costs little.
